name: icon-cloud
title: Icon Cloud
description: Labels or small icons sit on the surface of an invisible ball that turns slowly; dragging spins it and it coasts to a stop. The near side is large and sharp, the far side small and faint.

meta.reducedMotion: The ball, still, at a fixed angle; dragging still turns it (the visitor's own motion).
meta.useWhen: A collection the visitor browses for the pleasure of it (a herbarium's species, a type foundry's glyphs, a band's setlist history), with the full list available in text.
meta.avoidWhen: A logo wall of "technologies we use"; as navigation; more than about 40 items; small screens where a plain list reads better (below 300px wide it falls back to a wrapped list).
